profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer at PageTiger
profile.summary:
Highly experienced and motivated Front-end Software Engineer and User Experience professional, with extensive experience in delivering best-in-class cross-platform solutions through solid UCD principles and methodologies.

Naturally enthusiastic, I apply an agile approach, creative flair and keen eye for detail as I strive to deliver the ultimate user journey for any digital scenario by leveraging insight and new technology.

Key Skills
+ Over 18 years commercial experience in Front-end development, UX and design.
+ Defining end-to-end user journeys across mobile and desktop platforms.
+ Wireframing and prototyping to support the implementation of large-scale projects and the integration of new functionality. 
+ Interaction design, layout optimization and information architecture carried out as a standard of project delivery. 
+ Collaboration with key stakeholders and project managers to define project scope, build requirements and functional specifications. 
+ Analytical approach supported by strong research skills with excellent presentation skills. 
+ Understanding and management of MVT optimization, SEO, usability and web standards as a core part of deliverables across platform. 

Technical Skills
+ HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript, Sass, Node, Gulp, ASP, .NET, PHP, XML, SQL
+ 18 yrs experience developing industry leading web-based project management application using .NET MVC, HTML, CSS, JavaScript (es6/es2015).
+ Rapid prototyping, UI design and POC using popular libraries and frameworks such as JQuery, HTML5 Boilerplate and Twitter Bootstrap or hand-coded HTML5 and CSS3.
+ Adobe Creative Suite
+ Expertise in prototyping and wireframing in addition to being extremely competent in high-fidelity web design and concept development.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer - UI
positions.description: Working as Lead Software Engineer for UI within BGL's Business Technology department, I manage a small team of Software Engineers focused on providing front-end design/development support to numerous cross functional agile delivery teams as well as being SME and front-end lead within the departments Software Practices Team - responsible for defining code standards and best practices within the UI space.

positions.title: Senior UX Designer
positions.description:
Working as part of the user experience team at Rakuten’s Play.com, I’m responsible for delivering best-in-class UX solutions for numerous internal, B2B projects as well as B2C activity for the Play.com website itself, through the application of solid UXD principles and methodologies, covering all aspects of the UX project lifecycle from initial analysis and requirements gathering, task flows, end-to-end customer journeys, to wireframes and prototyping, information architecture and user testing.
In addition to this I am also a member of the MVT team, working closely alongside the UXD manager and BI team to manage the MVT roadmap to drive success and optimize designs across platform.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description:
Web Designer within the Rakuten Group Play.com commercial design team

Working closely alongside Play.com marketing, trading and commercial planning teams, my responsibilities included the design and execution for commercial initiatives, feature rich promotional pages and targeted newsletters as well as adopting the lead design role for several successful seasonal campaigns.

positions.title: UI Designer
positions.description:
UI Designer for Superfit.co.uk (Zena Healthcare).

Working within a small but highly skilled team, my day to day responsibilities as lead UI designer included commercial design, UX design and UI development for Elegant.com and SuperFit.co.uk both powered by the popular open source ecommerce platform Magento with the overall long term objective to redesign Superfit.co.uk.

In June 2011 SuperFit.co.uk was acquired by HealthSpark.co.uk.

positions.title: Web Developer / UI Designer
positions.description:
Working closely with the system development director to design and develop the user interface for three generations of the ePIN’s core product, a project collaboration and document management system. Originally written in classic ASP making the move over to Microsoft .NET framework in 2004 placing particular emphasis on web standards compliant XHTML, CSS and semantic mark-up. 
The new system included many new features not offered by its competitors and has been used to deliver solutions for global organisations including: Nissan, Toyota, Debenhams, Tesco, Safeway, British Land, Prologis and Turner & Townsend to name but a few. Responsiblities extended to ePIN's own website, various bespoke system modules, creation and application of branded system skins, POC's and functional prototyping and POC.
